Action.description:
Something a person may do: an operation with its request, or a shell line that is no
operation — a shell's activation, a scheduler's interactive command — on this machine, or on
another, `on`, where a surface writes it as a line for that machine and never runs it. Its
line and its effect are its operation's, computed from its call and serialized with it (web.md
§ 7.2), never stored beside it: an action read back from a file femkit keeps computes them
again, from the verbs femkit has then.

call.description: the operation it runs; none for a shell line

command.description: the line the command line writes for it: a value still to fill as what it asks for, never its example

effect.description: what its operation does, as its verb declares it: it reads, changes or removes; none for a shell line

fills.description: each value still to fill, in the order asked

label.description: what a person reads on it

note.description: a remark a command line writes after it

on.description: the machine it runs on, by its record's name, where that is not the one the page or the command line runs on: a line for that machine, its request's path fields from the project's folder, never run here; none: this machine

shell.description: the line a person types, for what is no operation
